## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      17 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Sep 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _srk3000_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "One of the worst apps to be using on iPad or the iPhone. Notion is only good on the Mac or MacBook. They have been terrible iOS and iPad OS for years now. I have been through multiple is upgrades from 18 to 27 now and when Apple is getting better with upgrades Notion is still in the same spot as it was before with no upgrades and only downgrades. I can’t make a calculate function to work on the app in the table on Notion as it keeps freezing and doesn’t work at all. It’s only okay for viewing things you made in your computer or laptop besides that you can’t create or do anything in iPad."
            2. _Tamia413_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "App is now too glitchy to use, makes typing a little more diffficult on mobile as the screen keeps moving every time I type."
            3. _.oliviaaa_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
